sql: SELECT c.instance_id = '9b846163-9580-436b-a33e-1e0eca106514' AS v1, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24') AS h, coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '(sem)') AS src, m.message_type AS tipo, m.status, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) AS conversas FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.from_me AND c.instance_id IN ('9b846163-9580-436b-a33e-1e0eca106514', '3f39419e-e7f5-4c3b-8ebd-1703e6c7a0c7') AND m.timestamp >= '2026-10-16T03:00:00Z' AND m.timestamp < '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 6 DESC
